title: Saharwon Kapaiwon
notes: Acclaimed Naga folk-blues track blending traditional Tangkhul melody with acoustic guitar and folk harmonica.

lines_tangkhul: Saharwon kapaiwon, kaphungli won kapha wonri.
Choithar ramwui ningyangla, leikashi khangatei lei.
lines_translation: Saharwon gentle flower, blooming on the high mountain slopes.
Sweet delight of Choithar village, pure love unchanging through time.
